name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
tagline: Open-source geocoding and reverse-geocoding API powered by OpenStreetMap data
description: Nominatim is OpenStreetMap’s free geocoding service for forward search (place names to coordinates), reverse geocoding (coordinates to addresses), and structured address lookups. The public instance at nominatim.openstreetmap.org is intended for light, policy-compliant use with no SLA; commercial users should plan for an alternative provider or self-hosting. Responses are typically JSON (or XML/GeoJSON) and require a valid User-Agent or email for identification.

auth.details: No API key. Public instance requires a valid HTTP User-Agent identifying the application, and preferably a contact email (via User-Agent or email= query param). No self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public instance free for policy-compliant light use (including moderate end-user-triggered app/website use); no SLA—access may be withdrawn; commercial apps should not depend on continued availability; heavy/regular bulk use must self-host or use third-party providers
pricing.paid_plans: No paid plans from OSM; commercial Nominatim hosting available from third parties (e.g. LocationIQ, Geoapify, self-hosted)

rate_limits: Absolute maximum 1 request/second on public nominatim.openstreetmap.org; identify with valid User-Agent or Referer; cache results. Bulk geocoding discouraged—smaller one-time jobs may be allowed (single thread, one machine); scripts lasting over a day or run regularly limited to 4 requests/minute. Systematic queries, autocomplete-on-API, and reselling primary geocoding services forbidden.
use_cases: geocode a place name or address to latitude/longitude
reverse-geocode coordinates to a human-readable address
look up OpenStreetMap place IDs and bounding boxes for a location
autocomplete or disambiguate place names for map UIs
resolve structured address components (street, city, country) to coordinates
